scope: Direct current Xenoverse 2 evidence refresh for Skill Research Batch 316.

records.name: Blaster Stream
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 148 - Finding Out About Fusion
records.mechanics: Chargeable straight-line beam; charging increases damage and hit count, with the move described as up to 35 hits; a second Ki Wave follows a successful first hit. Fully charged use requires a hard knockdown or stamina break to land the extended sequence.

records.name: Full Power Destruction
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 177 - Warped Sense of Justice
records.mechanics: Immediately fires five tracking Ki Blasts; if the opening connects, a follow-up Ki Blast sequence occurs before a short cinematic explosion at the target. The attack is long-range, tracking, multi-hit, and knockback-capable.

records.name: Gigantic Burst
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 127 - Multiverse Match of the Century
records.mechanics: Two-stage Ultimate: three sweeping Ray Blasts are followed by a charged spinning-disc energy wave; current evidence describes 25 hits and about 40% damage. Ray Blast can transition directly into Gigantic Burst when enough Ki remains for both skills.

records.name: Lightning Impact
records.mechanics: The user rises and fires a beam from both hands. Charging is performed by rapidly pressing the input; while charging the user is invulnerable and opponents that touch the user are paralyzed. Current dedicated evidence describes 20 hits at base charge and increased damage when fully charged.

records.name: Requiem of Destruction
records.mechanics: Creates a large Ki sphere around the opponent, paralyzing them before the sphere detonates; current evidence describes 3 hits and about 40% total damage. The skill is associated with Super Pack 2 and can be added to Whis's Customize Partner skillset.

evidence_boundary: Direct current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence was used for identity, Ki cost, acquisition endpoint, and directly stated mechanics. Ultimate Finish requirements, reward probabilities, shop prices, exact frame data, version-sensitive damage, and unresolved CaC fields were not inferred.
